subject: [RFC PATCH 3/6] mm/page_alloc: add an alloc_flags-aware folio allocator

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch adds an alloc_flags-aware folio allocator to the Linux kernel's page allocation system, allowing for more flexible and customizable memory allocation behavior. The existing exported folio and node interfaces remain unchanged, with ALLOC_DEFAULT being used as a wrapper. This change is intended to provide a low-level interface that can be used internally by the MM subsystem without affecting external users of the folio allocator.
